title: Reference images reach the image editor
summary:
Reference images and better aspect-ratio guidance expanded image generation, while text model routing got a tidy-up.

The image editor now accepts up to four reference images for nanobanana, seedream, and kontext, adding them to generated URLs only for supported models. The image API also accepts reference-image URLs separated by pipes or commas. Image request spacing was corrected for nanobanana and seedream.

Non-square width and height requests now give nanobanana aspect-ratio guidance alongside any user reference images. Square requests skip the extra guidance.

`geminisearch` was added as an alias for `searchgpt`, and Gemini 2.5 Flash’s Vertex model ID was corrected for routing. The probability of adding referral links also changed from 3% to 5%.

highlights.title: Reference images in the editor
highlights.text: Add up to four reference images when generating with nanobanana, seedream, or kontext in the image editor. [Try the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Flexible reference image URLs
highlights.text: Pass multiple reference-image URLs to supported image models using pipes or commas as separators. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Nanobanana follows non-square dimensions
highlights.text: Set a non-square width and height to give nanobanana aspect-ratio guidance, even when you also supply reference images. [Browse nanobanana](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).

highlights.title: Search with `geminisearch`
highlights.text: Use `geminisearch` as another name for the `searchgpt` model in text requests. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
